source.title: The Last Caretaker – Complete Sample Location List
source.author: SoulKilla

coordinateConvention: Coordinates are 'X, Y' from the thread: X = longitude, Y = latitude. exactCoordinates: true means the coordinates are the sample itself; otherwise they point at the named location/POI and the note explains where to find the sample.
